title: Algorithms for Robbins' Problem using Markov Decision Processes
summary: In this paper, we consider Robbins' problem, which is a full information variant of the well-known secretary selection problem. In this version of the problem, the goal is to minimize the expected rank of the selected candidate among $n$ that are interviewed sequentially, and a decision to select or not the $m^{th}$ candidate needs to be taken right after the interview (so without seeing the last $n-m$ candidates and without recall).
